mapper.sql: SELECT strategyId, useStatus, strategyName, '' type2, strategyId ||',1' assetTypeId, '' fiterFlag, '' hasChildren, '' batchId, SUM(RATIO*100) ratio FROM (SELECT DISTINCT inv.STRATEGY_ID strategyId, inv.USE_STATUS useStatus, inv.STRATEGY_NAME strategyName, det.RATIO ,detClass.batch_id FROM PTL_INV_STRATEGY inv LEFT JOIN PTL_INV_STRATEGY_DETAIL det ON inv.STRATEGY_ID = det.STRATEGY_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_INV_STRATEGY_DETAIL_CLASS detClass ON det.BATCH_ID = detClass.BATCH_ID ) GROUP BY strategyId, strategyName, useStatus ORDER BY strategyId, strategyName

SELECT '' strategyId, '' useStatus, '' strategyName, to_char(wm_concat(DISTINCT detClass.TYPE_2)) type2, inv.STRATEGY_ID||',1,'||detClass.BATCH_ID assetTypeId, #{parentId} pAssetTypeId, '1' fiterFlag, '01' hasChildren, detClass.BATCH_ID batchId, det.RATIO*100 ratio FROM PTL_INV_STRATEGY inv LEFT JOIN PTL_INV_STRATEGY_DETAIL det ON inv.STRATEGY_ID = det.STRATEGY_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_INV_STRATEGY_DETAIL_CLASS detClass ON det.BATCH_ID = detClass.BATCH_ID
GROUP BY inv.STRATEGY_ID,det.RATIO,detClass.BATCH_ID ORDER BY det.RATIO
